notes.title: 1.10 release
notes.content:
- Surface tool improvements​
- Save tool settings between sessions​
- VDB Density Field Import (as clay) and Export​
- A lot of UX Improvements

See full release notes here:  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes/v1-10-release-notes.html

1.4.1 release.  See post with release notes

Changes:
[list]
[*] Top bar menus now close automatically when they are no longer focused.
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where importing a mesh and breaking it into submeshes could break save files.
[*] Fixed an issue where using the File menu could cause VR controls not to work properly.
[*] Improved handling for importing textured FBX files.
[/list]
